title: My first real project
author: UFCFan918
selftext:
Hey everyone!

So I've been developing a game called **Desktop Sports**, and it's finally reached the point where it's playable. With that being said It's still in Alpha, so there's plenty left to add and polish, but I'd love to start getting feedback from people outside my own testing.

I have found using Rosebud AI among other AI programs have significantly improved my ability to address and reimagine my line of thinking and progression. AI has opened doors I didn't think we're possible until recently. 

Current features:

* 🎮 13 mini-games
* 👥 1–4 player support
* 🏆 Steam leaderboards for every mini-game
* 🌎 Offline play
* 🔥 5 difficulty levels
* ⭐ 5 prestige levels with unlockables
* 🎵 Unlockable menu music

Future plans include adding more mini games, more unique unlockables, as well as unique prestige and avatar icons. 

You can try it right now for free by using the link above.  

  
Feedback/thoughts meaning everything!
